en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a river scene with a long paddle steamer named "DRESDEN" traveling past grand riverside buildings and a castellated villa labeled "Geipel-Burg". Forested hills rise behind the buildings. Printed captions at the top read "Meissen." and "Geipelburg."; additional German text is visible on the riverside building, and a red handwritten number appears in the sky area.
